selection_policy.purpose: curated non-interpretive coordinate anchors requested in GitHub Discussion 19
selection_policy.extended_object_policy: a catalog center is an angular anchor, not a physical point mass
selection_policy.host_star_policy: confirmed host identity is checked against NASA; runtime position delegates to the sovereign star registry
selection_policy.solar_system_exclusion: planets, satellites, asteroids, comets, and interstellar visitors require time-dependent ephemerides and are excluded

coordinate_model.runtime_path: class-admitted SIMBAD proper motion; Moira IAU 2006 precession; IAU 2000A nutation; true obliquity
coordinate_model.proper_motion_policy: only selected cluster centers and stellar compact systems use SIMBAD proper motion; galaxy, nebula, remnant, quasar, and Galactic-center anchors remain fixed at their released J2000 coordinate
coordinate_model.observer_model: geocentric direction only; no topocentric parallax or atmospheric refraction
